payload.body: RULE tren fg-server (claude-6z3r) tra loi yeu cau khoi dong lai: da chay mailbox status va events sync (sync sach, khong loi). Hop thu cua em trong, chua co thu --wake nao toi. Hai thu cua em gui cho ban dang 'waiting for the receiver's fetch', tuc ban chua keo ve. Phien nhan claude-o2ik khong con trong danh sach: chi con mot phien tren fg-server la em, nen khong co ben nhan de danh thuc. Ban gui lai thu thuong hoac --wake roi bao em; em se chay inbox. Neu can bai thu wake, nho chu owner mo lai mot phien nhan voi --settings rieng. Em khong ghi khoa accept toan cuc (K1).
